goal: Remove GitHub Copilot as a required execution dependency so an approved A0-A2 Mission Control contract can queue a replaceable worker backend, beginning with a self-hosted local-model runner that returns a verified PR.
constraints: Only Michael/repository owner may approve dispatch.
Worker must open a PR and may not merge/deploy/send/spend.
Local worker must use synthetic/approved data only and respect each target repo AGENTS.md.
Offline or unavailable providers must surface as queued/blocked rather than simulated progress.
done_when: Mission intake creates or reuses an idempotent target contract without requiring Copilot.
Self-hosted workflow can be queued from an approved mission and waits truthfully when the runner is offline.
Worker reads the target harness, invokes an allowlisted local backend, runs repository-owned verification and records a receipt.
Successful work pushes an isolated branch and opens a PR for human review.
A3/A4, missing local backend, verifier failure and provider failure all fail closed.
CI and public snapshot build pass.
forbidden: Treating local-model output as verified without repo-owned checks

evidence.failure: GitHub Copilot cloud-agent assignment requires unavailable paid capability
evidence.decision: make providers replaceable; preserve GitHub as state/evidence layer

uncertainties: The first self-hosted machine still needs one-time GitHub runner, Ollama and local coding-agent setup before a real model-backed mission can execute.
Local model choice must be configured to match available hardware; Mission Control must not silently choose an oversized model.
next_step: Implement provider-neutral dispatch plus self-hosted local worker, verify in CI, then queue the already-approved Council #28 mission against the new backend.
